vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: bx-search
Version: 1.0.0

The bx-search skill is a legitimate wrapper for the Brave Search CLI (bx), designed to provide AI agents with web grounding and RAG capabilities. The installation metadata and documentation point to official Brave GitHub repositories (github.com/brave/brave-search-cli), and the instructions in SKILL.md are consistent with the tool's stated purpose. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found; the skill even includes security tips for managing API keys safely.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions match a Brave Search CLI integration: it only needs the bx binary and a Brave Search API key and its install/usage steps align with the described purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Brave Search CLI) align with required binaries (bx) and the single env var (BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY). The requested artifacts are expected for a CLI wrapper around Brave's Search API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md confines actions to installing/using the bx CLI, configuring the API key, and invoking bx subcommands. It does not ask the agent to read unrelated files, other credentials, or system-wide secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No formal install spec in the skill bundle (instruction-only), but the README suggests a curl|sh installer and metadata points to GitHub release binaries. Using GitHub releases and the repo's raw install script is common, but running remote install scripts (curl | sh) has higher risk than using vetted package managers; prefer verifying the release binary and checksums before running.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY is required and is declared as the primary credential. The skill documents expected config file locations for storing the key. This is proportionate for a hosted search API client.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled and requests no system-wide privileges beyond storing its own config file (~/.config or platform equivalents). It is allowed to be invoked autonomously by default (platform normal), but that is not excessive given its purpose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for using Brave Search via the bx CLI. Before installing: verify you are using the official Brave GitHub repo/release URLs and, when possible, download the release binary and verify its checksum instead of piping an install script directly to sh. Protect your BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY (use environment variables or the CLI's interactive config, avoid passing the key on the command line), limit its scope in the Brave dashboard if possible, and rotate it periodically. If you don't want the agent to call bx autonomously, disable autonomous invocation in the agent settings.
